title: Brew unit fault
shortDescription: Brew unit jam or position error.
fullDescription:
Error 01 on Gaggia Anima and other super-automatics indicates the brew unit cannot reach home position. Caused by jammed grounds, worn gears, or failing motor.

Most cases resolve with a deep clean and lubrication.

fixSteps.title: Remove and clean
fixSteps.instruction: Eject brew unit, rinse, dry, lubricate.

title: Grinder fault
fullDescription: Error 02 indicates the grinder cannot rotate. Stones or worn burrs are typical.

title: Hydraulic circuit blocked
fullDescription: Error 03 - too-fine grind or scaled boiler causes pump to hit pressure limit.

title: Heating timeout
fullDescription: Error 04 - heating element scaled or failed.

title: Communication error
fullDescription: Error 05 indicates a communication failure between the main board and a peripheral. Often resolved by power cycle.

title: Air in circuit / pump prime fault
fullDescription: Error 06 - air lock after running tank dry. Prime via hot water dispense.

title: Classic Pro - low brew pressure
shortDescription: Pump runs but pressure stays below 6 bar.
fullDescription: Classic Pro has no display - this is a symptom code. Causes: failing OPV, worn pump diaphragm, or air lock.

fixSteps.title: Adjust OPV
fixSteps.instruction: Set OPV to 9 bar with portafilter blank.

faq.a: Yes, OPV mod is widely done.

title: Classic Pro - no steam from wand
fullDescription: Classic Pro - clogged steam tip or scaled boiler.

title: Empty drip tray prompt
fullDescription: Anima/Babila prompts after set cycles. Reset by removing with machine on.

title: Water tank low
fullDescription: Standard low-water prompt; check float for scale.
